[EN] [Dungeon - 463] Gossamer Vault (Easy)
[ES] [Mazmorra - 463] Cámara de Seda (Fácil)
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gossamer Vault (Hard)
[ES] Cámara de Seda (Difícil)
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This place seems to be artificial. How could such a place exist?
[ES] Este lugar parece artificial. ¿Cómo puede existir algo así?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter Gossamer Vault (Hard) through the {@LinkCreature:27#3201#teleportal}.
[ES] Entra a la Cámara de Seda (Difícil) a través del {@LinkCreature:27#3201#teleportal}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Extraction Chamber Entrance
[ES] Entrada a la cámara de extracción
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The cave is full of nectar with a peculiar, azure glow.
[ES] La cueva está llena de néctar con un brillo azulado peculiar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Jump down and go to the Extraction Chamber.
[ES] Salta y ve a la cámara de extracción.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat the Hellgrammite.
[ES] Derrota al hellgrammite.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Processing Room Entrance
[ES] Entrada a la sala de procesamiento
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You feel a shock wave coming from the Processing Room.
[ES] Sientes una onda expansiva proveniente de la sala de procesamiento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Processing Room Entrance.
[ES] Ve a la entrada de la sala de procesamiento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Regent's Vault Entrance
[ES] Entrada a la cámara del regente
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] There's no sign of any butterflies...just eggs.
[ES] No hay señales de mariposas... solo huevos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Escape the Processing Room and go to the Regent's Vault.
[ES] Escapa de la sala de procesamiento y ve a la cámara del regente.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the eggs and defeat the Nightmare Gossamer Regent.
[ES] Destruye los huevos y derrota al regente de seda de pesadilla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the {@LinkCreature:3201#1501#Teleportal} to escape Gossamer Vault (Hard) and speak with Elleon.
[ES] Usa el {@LinkCreature:3201#1501#Teleportal} para escapar de la Cámara de Seda (Difícil) y habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Amarre.
[ES] Habla con Amarre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
